findings.title: Wired test probed one representative per rule, so weakening a live rule (dropping an include path, one of two dash forbids, or a no-web forbid) passed green
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a future rewrite drops judge-arch/SKILL.md from the ratchet to get CI green after reintroducing a dash; all wired tests stay green and the dash merges, while the ADR says it is mechanically locked
findings.evidence: reviewer copied the committed config, removed judge-arch/SKILL.md from the house include (7->6), re-ran tests 2+3 -> both still passed; a planted em dash in judge-arch/SKILL.md then ran exit 0
findings.resolution: strengthened test 2 to assert every REQUIRED_INCLUDE path + both dash forbids + every no-web forbid stay present; test 3 now probes EVERY include entry; added an en-dash probe; re-verified by reproducing the drop -> test 2 now fails with 'ratchet regressed' (exit 1), config restored

findings.title: ADR-0015 evidence ledger row 1 misquoted the gate output and pinned a file count the cited command no longer reproduces
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: an evidence ledger whose quoted output does not match its own re-runnable command erodes the re-runnable-evidence credibility the repo sells
findings.evidence: reviewer ran npm run check:architecture -> 'scanned 204 file(s)' then a PASS line with 'no architecture violations' (not 201, not a comma)
findings.resolution: row 1 now quotes real substrings (PASS, no architecture violations) and drops the brittle count ('about 200; tracks the tree')

dash scan across the scoped skill dirs + both READMEs -> 0 (reviewer node scan)
